editorial.name: Less.js
editorial.descriptionZh: Alexis Sellier 发起、Less Core Team 维护的 CSS 语言扩展 Less.js，现为 v4.9.1。仓库 LICENSE 标 Apache-2.0。用变量、mixin 与嵌套写样式，lessc 编译成 CSS。
editorial.takeawayZh: 装 lessc，把 mixin 编成 CSS
editorial.noteZh: lesscss.org 首页标题 Getting started，副标题 It's CSS, with just a little more。Features 页从 Overview 列到 Variables。Using Less.js 写 Command Line Usage 与 npm install less -g。Apache-2.0 覆盖源码。

reasons.statement: 首页把 Less 定义为 backwards-compatible language extension for CSS，并把 Less.js 定义为把 Less 样式转成 CSS 的 JavaScript 工具，同时给出 npm install -g less 与 lessc styles.less styles.css。
Using Less.js 给出 Command Line Usage 与 npm install less -g，证明交付物是可安装的 lessc 编译器，不是现成界面组件包。

facts.evidence: About History 写 Less was created in 2009 by Alexis Sellier。Core team 把 Alexis Sellier 标 Original Author。packages/less package.json author 为 Alexis Sellier <self@cloudhead.net>，contributors 为 The Core Less Team。
About 写 In May 2012 Alexis turned over control and development to a core team of contributors，并写 No one person is in charge。GitHub 组织 less 维护仓库。LICENSE 与 package.json 未见独立公司主体。
packages/less package.json repository.url 为 https://github.com/less/less.js.git，homepage 为 http://lesscss.org。首页 View the Less.js changelog 链到 github.com/less/less.js。

LICENSE 标题 Apache License Version 2.0, January 2004，止于 END OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS。packages/less package.json license 字段为 Apache-2.0。About License FAQs 写 Less.js is released under the Apache 2 License，Copyright 2009-2023, Alexis Sellier and the Less Core Team。该许可覆盖 Less.js 编译器源码，不覆盖 /tools 第三方列表。
首页与 Features、Mixins 文档公开可读。安装走 npm install -g less。未见付费墙。About License FAQs 写可免费用于 personal, company internal or commercial purposes。
首页写 npm install -g less 与 lessc styles.less styles.css。packages/less package.json name 为 less，version 4.9.1，bin.lessc 为 ./bin/lessc。npm registry latest 同为 4.9.1，license Apache-2.0。
